name: publicWeb_setNotificationPrefs
description: The bell and the envelope on the web (E9.F7.S14): a web member's push-notification and email-alert preference for one kennel (HasherKennelMap) or one run (HasherEventMap), through the app's own hcapp_setEmailAndNotificationPrefs. The wrapper resolves the public ids, takes the hasher from the device row (always the caller — never a parameter) and range-checks the values; auth (token signed for 'hcapp_setEmailAndNotificationPrefs') and the write are the inner SP's. Values are the app's: notification 0 auto · 1 on · 2 ignore · 3 mute · 4 on before the run; email 0 · 1 on · 2 off; -1 = leave unchanged. When both public ids resolve the inner SP uses event scope. Reachable only through PublicWebAdminApi behind HC_INTERNAL_SECRET.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The calling browser's HC.Device id (the browser is a registered device). No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Device-bound token signed for 'hcapp_setEmailAndNotificationPrefs' (the inner SP validates it under its own name via HC6.ValidateAppAuth). No SQL default.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: Kennel scope (HasherKennelMap). One of the two public ids must resolve.

parameters.name: notificationPreference
parameters.description: -1 (default, unchanged), 0 auto, 1 on, 2 ignore, 3 mute, 4 on before the run. Event scope writes HasherEventMap.EventNotificationPreference.
parameters.typeMismatch: Column is SMALLINT; the parameter (and the inner SP's) is INT — values are range-checked first, so nothing is lost.

parameters.name: emailPreference
parameters.description: -1 (default, unchanged), 0, 1 on, 2 off. Event scope writes HasherEventMap.EventEmailAlertPreference.
parameters.typeMismatch: Column is SMALLINT; the parameter is INT — range-checked first.

rowsets.name: WrapperRefusal
rowsets.description: Wrapper refusal before the EXEC: no live device row for @deviceId (removed = 0), neither public id resolves to a live kennel/run, or a preference outside its range → { success 0, errorCode 1230, errorType 12 }, logged to HC.ErrorLog.
Follows WrapperRefusal: errorTitle 'Not found', errorUserMessage 'That kennel or run could not be found.'

rowsets.name: WriteEnvelope
rowsets.description: From hcapp_setEmailAndNotificationPrefs: Always the first rowset.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. ValidateAppAuth code; 1214 missing scope; 1914 unhandled (CATCH).

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 1 bad token / 3 device not found / 7 signed out (ValidateAppAuth); 12 validation; 19 unhandled.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: From hcapp_setEmailAndNotificationPrefs: Rowset 1 on failure only (success = 0). Every path writes HC.ErrorLog.

rowsets.name: PrefsResult
rowsets.description: From hcapp_setEmailAndNotificationPrefs: Rowset 1 on success: the effective preferences after the write, read back for the UI.

columns.name: notificationPreference
columns.description: Event scope: COALESCE(HEM.EventNotificationPreference, HKM.KennelNotificationPreference) via an INNER JOIN on the HKM row — NULL when the hasher has no HKM row for the kennel. Kennel scope: HKM.KennelNotificationPreference.

columns.name: emailAlertPreference
columns.description: Event scope: COALESCE(HEM.EventEmailAlertPreference, HKM.KennelEmailAlertPreference), same join caveat. Kennel scope: HKM.KennelEmailAlertPreference.

rowsets.name: SyncUserDataRowsets
rowsets.description: From hcapp_setEmailAndNotificationPrefs: Rowsets 2+ on success: HC6.hcapp_syncUserData with the HEM/HKM watermarks passed through, hashers and narrow events 'ignore', @usePaging 0. See that contract. The wrapper passes '2050-01-01' for both watermarks, so these sync rowsets come back empty (shape only); the web re-reads its own screens.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.HasherKennelMap (prefs COALESCEd to 0) when kennel scope and no row for (@hasherId, @kennelId) (lines 129-136) — this also creates a follow-like row for a kennel the hasher had no relationship with.
UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap Kennel*Preference, updatedAt when kennel scope and the row exists (lines 140-144).
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap with KennelId, Event*Preference (0 stored as NULL), updatedAt when event scope and no row (lines 161-168) — RsvpState/AttendenceState take the table defaults (0).
UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap Event*Preference, updatedAt when event scope and the row exists (lines 172-176).
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on the missing-scope refusal (line 96) and in the CATCH (line 214).
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on the wrapper refusal (1230).

On an error that escapes the inner SP the CATCH rolls back, logs 'Unhandled error in publicWeb_setNotificationPrefs' to HC.ErrorLog (HcVersion '<web>', deviceId) and returns { success 0, errorCode 1500, errorType 5 } alone (no detail rowset).

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken (line 16-17) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one fails with 'expects parameter' before the SP runs: PublicWebAdminApi's catch logs only a generic exception row and returns 500, and the SP's own graceful checks and error envelope never run.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
